decisions.evidence: Overall, the mixed structural cues are not strongly aligned with the common 3CLpro-recognition motifs, so the molecule is more likely to be a non-binder, despite the favorable size and drug-likeness descriptors.
On balance, the analog evidence supports the query as a non-binder, so the final call is option (A): does not bind SARS-CoV-2 3CL protease.
